reviewer: independent read-only G7 public/private identity review

findings.title: G7 formal preflight accepted replacement case in the frozen public/private set
findings.evidence: The pre-repair mutation replaced one immutable case ID, synchronized its public label hash and plan mappings, and was accepted while retaining 92 rows, exact public/label equality, 23 families, CF1-CF4 coverage, and complete checkpoints.
findings.remediation: Freeze and enforce the exact audited 92-case corrected public set and add an adversarial replacement-case regression test.

resolutions.evidence: The strict contract now compares the public case set with the frozen 92-case corrected set. The replacement-case test passes; focused G7 tests pass 56/56; the full suite passes 246/246; immutable preflight and an independent data-only scan report the exact case set with no missing or extra IDs.
resolutions.reason: Local formal case-identity defect fixed; provider, provenance, mathematical, statistical, and scientific-release gates remain external or blocked.
